profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Patreon
profile.summary: Passionate about all things related to mobile development. I specialize in building large-scale Android applications with a focus on clean architecture and product-minded engineering.

positions.title: Web Designer
positions.description: I help manage website development and updates for Berkeley's largest entertainment organization. My work involves streamlining the website to create an efficient and enjoyable user experience.

positions.title: Tech Consultant/Repairs Person
positions.description: I worked as a technology consultant and repair person at the Berkshire Hathaway Real Estate Office in Dana Point where my job involved streamlining data transfer between agents and clients.

honors.title: Regents' and Chancellor's Scholarship
honors.description: I received Berkeley's sole and premier academic scholarship on the basis of my academic achievement in high school, and my varied extra-curricular work.
honors.issuer: Issued by UC Berkeley Regents and Chancellor · Aug 2016
